scenarios.task: Run EMT conduit along the Charter Hall ceiling grid for agent workstation circuits
steps: Lock out the panel feeding the workstation circuit
Measure and cut EMT to layout marks with a proper bender
Deburr cut ends and assemble couplings and supports
Pull THHN conductors and torque terminal connections
Megger the run and label circuits in the panel schedule
Restore power only after inspection sign-off

rubric.pass_if: Lock and tag applied before any panel work
Conduit runs straight, supports within code spacing
Insulation resistance test passes before re-energizing

scenarios.task: Set interior glass debate-partition panels on the mezzanine without crane access
steps: Stage panels vertically on A-frames near the opening
Inspect suction cups and vacuum seal before each lift
Two-person lift with glass carriers, communicate each move
Set panel into channel, shim plumb, and secure with setting blocks
Apply edge trim and clean without leaning on the panel

rubric.pass_if: Suction equipment inspected and rated for panel weight
Verbal calls before every lift and move
Panel plumb within tolerance and fully secured

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and rotates glass panels at the channel under glazier control to reduce pinch-point exposure during final set.

scenarios.task: Reset settled precast pavers along the lake promenade viewing deck
steps: Cordon the work area from promenade pedestrians
Lift and stack settled pavers clear of the bed
Re-level the sand bedding with a screed
Reset pavers tight and flush, check pattern lines
Compact with plate compactor in overlapping passes
Sweep joint sand and remove barricades only when passable

rubric.pass_if: Barricades in place before lifting begins
No lips over 6 mm between pavers
Compactor handled with two hands and hearing protection worn

scenarios.task: Replace a fouled chilled-water coil in the server-adjacent air handler for the lab
hazards: refrigerant and chilled-water lines under pressure
steps: Verify lockout of handler disconnect and pump isolation valves
Drain and vent the coil circuit before cutting lines
Remove access panels and cut pipe with tubing cutter
Slide old coil out, install new coil with gasket seals
Braze connections, pressure test with nitrogen, then recharge water circuit
Restart unit and verify airflow and temperatures

rubric.pass_if: Electrical and hydraulic energy both locked out
Nitrogen pressure test holds with no drop
Work order updated with pressures and readings

scenarios.task: Rig and set steel canopy beams over the Charter Hall entry in a tight lakeside old-town street
hazards: public traffic in old town lane
steps: Complete lift plan and set exclusion zone with barricades
Inspect slings, shackles and beam clamps for tags and damage
Rig beams at marked center of gravity points
Tagline the load and guide it with hands clear
Land, align bolt holes, and install erection bolts
Unrig only after load is fully connected and stable

rubric.pass_if: All gear tagged and inspected before use
No personnel under load at any time
All erection bolts installed before slings released

scenarios.robot_role: Carries taglines and walks the exclusion zone perimeter checking for pedestrian intrusion during the pick.

scenarios.task: Mount rooftop PV modules on standing-seam metal roof of the observatory
steps: Establish anchor points and perimeter warning line
Stage modules with seam clamps, no roof penetrations
Clamp modules to seams per torque spec
Wire strings in series, keep connectors capped until test day
Torque-check all clamps and label string conductors
Housekeep tools and debris before leaving roof

rubric.pass_if: Harness tied off 100% of roof time
All seam clamps torqued to specification
Connectors capped and labeled until commissioning

scenarios.task: Retrofit sprinkler branch lines in the occupied proposal debate hall ceiling
steps: Confirm system impairment with fire department and building owner
Drain the zone and verify with flow check
Cut and groove new branch line from the riser
Hang branch with listed hangers and attach sprinkler heads
Hydrostatic test at 200 psi for 2 hours
Restore system and post impairment tags removed only after inspection

rubric.pass_if: Impairment notice filed and system drained before cutting
Hydro test holds 2 hours with zero loss
Heads spaced and deflector positions per design

scenarios.task: Inspect and clear the lakeside storm outfall serving the DAO building drainage
hazards: boat and barge traffic on the lake
ppe: surface-supplied or SCUBA with dry suit
steps: Complete dive plan, hazard assessment and communications check
Post tenders and display dive flag to lake traffic
Descend the guideline and assess outfall grate condition
Clear debris by hand, bag and send up loads
Record grate and pipe condition for the survey report
Ascend on line with decompression or safety stop per tables

rubric.pass_if: Dive plan, tender and comms verified before water entry
Dive flag displayed and zone marked on surface
Grate cleared and condition documented

scenarios.robot_role: Towed surface platform carries dive flag, spare tanks and tool bags to the outfall site along the promenade.
